name: project-doc
description: Generate a modular documentation system from ALL project evidence — the invocation discourse, files, handoffs, memory, graph, git log, and session transcripts — kept in a versioned append-only journal, projected into a lightweight CLAUDE.md routing table + .claude/docs/*.md per concern + thin pointers (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules). FOUR skills: /project-doc (mines everything), /doc-touch (incremental), /start-doc (interviews the human for the authorial docs no mining can produce — and never invents them), and /design-md (absorbed from the standalone design-md plugin: writes/validates/exports Google's DESIGN.md format via the official CLI). v3.19.0: /start-doc becomes a concepção in FOUR stages of agreement, in order — authorial (quality goals, constraints, context, strategy, glossary), architecture (architecture-intent.md), interface (design.md, only where a UI is detected) and journeys (journeys.md). Each stage has its own document and its own approval: it is presented in full, grilled with /grill-me or /grill-with-docs, corrected and RE-PRESENTED until the owner is satisfied, and only closes once his approval is written into the document's own frontmatter (status: approved + approved:). The grilling is the path to the agreement, never its judge — it neither approves nor rejects. And the plan gate stopped settling for 'has docs' — a documented project whose own quality-goals.md is missing or still open is now REFUSED (no cap, it used to stay silent), and any open stage refuses the plan — architecture (architecture-intent.md), interface or journeys — including in a brand-new project that never opened one, which is exactly the case that used to slip through. v3.21.0: the gate and the authorial contract stopped disagreeing — the mark it demands is the contract's own status: approved ('ready' is 'written', 'approved' is 'the owner agreed'), the architecture stage is architecture-intent.md (not solution-strategy.md, which belongs to stage 1), and both refusal messages are written under the repo's hook style profile: emoji header, one-sentence bullets, no markdown in a channel that renders none. v3.17.0: the doc-touch stamp is now a verb (--restamp) that writes generated, generated-commit and doc-sig in one go, preserving the DOC-SET gen instead of the code's — a doc cannot cite the commit that contains it, so the ritual is two commits and the tool now owns it. v3.16.0: the staleness measure the HOOKS consume (project_staleness) now honors generated-commit instead of a day-granularity date window, and matches scope entries with _scope_match instead of raw string intersection — a /doc-touch followed by a same-day commit no longer reports freshly generated docs as stale, and a doc scoped by directory can finally go stale. v3.15.0: design.md becomes the 6th authorial doc, gated to projects with a detected frontend (lib-has-frontend.sh); sessionstart-doc.sh now also nudges when a mined project has zero authorial docs (not just when there's no doc at all). Gen 3.8 adds the data-asset axis (data-stores.md + durability.md: every store enumerated, every store's backup declared or explicitly justified), runtime.md end-to-end scenarios, verified-by provenance in frontmatter, and a project-root ADR log. A plan gate hook blocks planning in an undocumented project until /start-doc runs, with a verbal escape. Scrubber moves secrets to a vault, never to git. Supports delta/--deep/--rebuild, monorepo layouts, artifact cleanup, and ORGANISM support (de-silo) with an inverted blast-radius gate.
